behavior: Replaces the persistent arrow popup with one joystick near the keyboard controls. Press shows an 88dp direction indicator. Sliding beyond a 10dp/touch-slop neutral zone immediately sends one arrow; holding repeats after 350ms at 65ms intervals. Moving to center pauses; changing direction cancels old repeat; up/cancel/pane/control changes stop everything. Initial-pass consumption and local system-gesture exclusion prevent right drags triggering ancestor/back gestures. Callback target is frozen per gesture. Existing Shift/Ctrl/Alt pipeline and four accessibility direction actions are supported. Enter precedes joystick in the one-row dock; extra keys remain beside the keyboard icon.
phone_install: Installed release 33 on S22+ RFCT21390SD via USB; installed APK checksum matches verified artifact; app data preserved; app not launched
